messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident detected: KV cache eviction surge in prod-gpu pool (eu-1). Observed sharp increase in cache memory + continuous-batching amplification. Incident ID INC-20260315-72

morgan: I'm on it. Noticed elevated p99 latency on streaming endpoints ~12:03 UTC. Any customer-facing alerts?

priya: grabbing metrics now. cache_evictions/sec spiked from ~5 to ~1200 at 12:02. kv-cache memory climbed from 42% -> 96% on nodes; OOMs starting. Continuous batching throughput jumped too — batches of 8-12x typical size.

neil: streaming ingest shows token cadence stalls: tokenizer flush delays ~300ms leading to partial flushes. Seems related — large KV page thrash during batch assembly.

morgan: rolling a conservative hotfix: reduce batching window and throttle continuous batching by route. Preparing runtime patch.

priya: reproducing locally; found bug where batcher amplifies when prefix_kv misses coincide with long sequences. Quick mitigation: set batching.max_window_ms=5 and batching.max_batch_tokens=1024 for production models, and set kv_cache.eviction_margin to 0.95.

sam: do we have a single-line command to push? If so I can run.

priya: use the control plane patch: 
```
curl -XPOST https://control.redwood.internal/runtime/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"path":"/runtime/serving","patch": {"batching.max_window_ms":5,"batching.max_batch_tokens":1024,"kv_cache.eviction_margin":0.95}}'
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started: config change ID cfg-20260315-1101 -> targeting prod-gpu pool. 6 nodes -> 6/6 updated.

morgan: patch applied at 12:09 UTC. Observed immediate drop in eviction rate; cache memory stabilizing. p50/p95 latency back to normal, p99 improving. Monitoring.

cs-bot: Customer impact summary: 3 customers reported degraded streaming responses (slow tokens / truncated streams). Estimated affected window 12:02-12:14 UTC. CS assigned jamie for follow-up.

jamie: pinged customers with short note. Will follow up with detailed RCA once we have it.

neil: I see residual partial flush warnings in streaming logs tied to model: gpt-medium-v1. Kicking a targeted restart of serving shards for that model to clear stale KV pages.

morgan: did the shard restarts. No OOMs since patch. Marking incident as mitigated at 12:15 UTC. Root cause appears to be a regression in prefix-KV paging that increased page churn when combined with an aggressive continuous-batching change from last week.

morgan: Handoff to oncall for follow-up postmortem: neil you're taking ownership. I'll add incident notes and timeline.

neil: taking it. I'll collect traces, reproduce steps, and propose guardrails: circuit-breaker for batch amplification, eviction headroom alert, and model-specific batching caps.

priya: open question: rollback the previous batcher commit or patch the amplification logic? I'll prepare a small fix to early-detect amplification and backoff batching.

morgan: thanks everyone. Postmortem assignees: neil (owner), priya (fix), jamie (customer comms), sam (deploy validation). We'll sync in 1h in #incidents-bridge. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-72 marked MITIGATED by morgan at 12:15:23 UTC. Duration: 13m23s.
